<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="xQz5ads6H8aCEFkS1FIS"> <mxGraphModel dx="2167" dy="1189" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="1"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor Host as Candidate A (Host)
 actor Peer as Candidate B (Peer)
 participant FE as React / Next.js SPA
 participant Socket as Socket.io Server (buddy-socket-server.js)
 participant PythonAPI as FastAPI Backend (AIBuddyMode)
 participant Ollama as Local Ollama (gemma3:4b)
 participant Piston as Piston Local Server (Code Sandbox)
 participant DB as Firestore DB

 %% Room Creation & Question Generation
 Host->>FE: Click \"Create Buddy Room\"
 FE->>PythonAPI: POST /buddy/generate-question (Setup config)
 PythonAPI->>Ollama: Call Ollama with generation rubrics
 Ollama-->>PythonAPI: Return coding/interview question & boilerplate
 PythonAPI-->>FE: Return Question Details
 FE->>Socket: join-room (Generate Room ID)
 Socket-->>Host: Room created successfully

 %% Peer Joins Room
 Host->>Peer: Share Invite Link / Room ID
 Peer->>FE: Enter Room ID
 FE->>Socket: join-room (Room ID)
 Socket-->>Host: Peer Joined event
 Socket-->>Peer: Sync current editor code & state

 %% Live Sync Loop
 loop Collaborative Coding
 Host->>FE: Modifies code in editor
 FE->>Socket: code-update (code payload)
 Socket-->>Peer: code-sync (Update Peer's Monaco Editor)
 end

 %% Code Execution
 Host->>FE: Click \"Run Code\"
 FE->>Piston: POST /api/code-executor (Code & inputs)
 Piston-->>FE: Return execution stdout/stderr & testcase results
 FE->>Socket: testcase-status-sync (Notify Peer of run status)
 Socket-->>Peer: Display compilation status on Peer's UI

 %% Final Submission and AI Evaluation
 Host->>FE: Click \"Submit Final Answer\"
 FE->>Socket: submit-solution (Notify room)
 FE->>PythonAPI: POST /buddy/evaluate (Submit combined code & chat logs)
 
 Note over PythonAPI: Trigger Evaluator Module
 PythonAPI->>Ollama: Call Ollama (Grade code correctness & communication)
 Ollama-->>PythonAPI: Return scores (Technical, Rubrics alignment, Feedback)
 
 PythonAPI->>DB: Save session report and transcript
 PythonAPI-->>FE: Return evaluation JSON report
 FE->>Socket: session-completed (Send feedback payload)
 
 Socket-->>Host: Display Final Score Card & Suggestions
 Socket-->>Peer: Display Final Score Card & Suggestions
